treatment: Labelled retrospective holdings replay; excluded from claims of 1997 model selection skill.
Pre-listing capital stays in T-bills; current holdings are never presented as a historical universe.
The 25-month reconstructed decision history is reported separately and never spliced into the long replay.
Yahoo adjusted closes include splits and distributions where provider history supports them.
Historical FRED FX converts local adjusted closes to USD; ECU bridges pre-euro observations.
DAX is a performance index; other regional index series may omit dividends. SPY is included as a total-return proxy.
Commission, spread, slippage, square-root impact, missing-ADV penalty, and 5% ADV caps are reported.
A 25 bp charge is deducted once each December from then-current AUM; external benchmarks remain uncharged references.
Rate and market inputs are lagged one month; NBER recession labels are retrospective and are not presented as tradable signals.
Configured market-response windows overlap monthly returns and do not assert legal conflict dates or isolate causal effects.
Every tested allocation is long-only; no borrow availability or fee assumption is required.
Sidak FWER and Deflated Sharpe Ratios use both actual and correlation-clustered trial counts.
Embargo, subperiod plots, block resampling, fat tails, and EWMA volatility expose but cannot remove structural breaks.
